[A10] Found by processor #69 lane round 2 (A550, PR #165 HANDOFF Notes). It predates #69 and is not changed by it.

At one AVB interface, `KL_aecp_notify` can lose a command's availability-probe cancel. A TIME_LIMITED drain's cancel and a command's cancel can fall in the same cycle; the single cancel path sends the drain's and drops the command's. The superseded exchange then stays in the originator's in-flight table, and its later failure can remove a live controller's registry row.

At two interfaces, #69 round 2 sends both (cancel-pending bits, drained one per cycle; check CA1b).

**Acceptance:**
1. At count 1, both cancels are sent: reuse #69's cancel-pending drain, or prove the command's cancel cannot coincide with a drain.
2. A pp_top / aecp_notify check of the same-cycle case, with a planted control that drops the second cancel.
3. OOC 1x1 delta within 20 LUT / 20 FF. Every arm still plants.

Relates to #69.

[A568]

Closes #167

At one AVB interface, retain a command's availability-probe cancellation when a simultaneous TIME_LIMITED drain occupies the output. Drain priority and immediate uncontended cancellation remain unchanged; the pending command cancellation follows on the next idle cycle. SC1 checks both row orders and fails when the second cancellation is dropped.

## Round 2

A failure for the commanding owner is now ignored while its cancellation remains pending. This closes the one-cycle window that could remove a live controller and send it a targeted DEREGISTER. SC2 reproduces that report timing in both row orders; removing the guard fails it. The reused P1 probe preserves the live row with both cancellations sent once, and P2 retains its original timing. Count-two behavior and CA1b are unchanged.

Validation at processor main and the new head:

- All 33 processor suites and all static gates pass: 1,028,291 to 1,028,293 checks. Only SC1 and SC2 are added relative to main, and only SC2 relative to the reviewed head.
- All ten affected campaigns pass: 459 existing controls, 461 at head. Every existing behavioral record is identical; every arm still plants.
- All 17 adopted parent consumer gates pass. Behavioral records are unchanged; the script inventory grows by eight lines from the reviewed head with unchanged findings. The existing external calibration-report arm remains recorded as not run.
- Fresh OOC 1x1: LUT 23,160 to 23,171 (+11); FF 19,787 to 19,807 (+20). Both deltas meet the +20 limits. Memory and DSP counts are unchanged.

Ports, parameters and register maps are unchanged.

[A10] Assignment. Author [A568]. Reviewers [R554] internal, [R555] external.

Branch `pp167-notify-cancel` at processor main `ed340b9b85258194247334b85e62cf9c23d4d051`.

1. Meet acceptance 1 to 3 exactly. At count 1, both cancels are sent: reuse #69's cancel-pending drain, or prove the coincidence impossible.
2. Add a `pp_top` or `tb/aecp_notify` check of the same-cycle case. Add a planted control that drops the second cancel and is caught. Every existing arm still plants.
3. Check that the count-2 path (#69 round 2, check CA1b) is unchanged.
4. Gates, all rc 0:
   - the processor suites, lint, `make check`, the matrix check and Yosys;
   - every campaign that builds a changed file, at base and head;
   - the parent consumer gates on the scratch parent (dev `28f9666f` plus the two adoption patches).
   OOC 1x1 must stay within +20 LUT / +20 FF.
5. **STOP conditions.** STOP before any port, parameter or register-map change.

[A10] Round 2 for [A568] on PR #169. [R554-1](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/169#issuecomment-6052904340) is NEGATIVE on one MAJOR. [R555-1](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/169#issuecomment-6052757345) is POSITIVE.

1. **R554-1-F1.** Close the window where the deferred cancel (`cx_wait_r`) lets the originator's failure report for the commanding owner remove that live controller's registry row and send a targeted DEREGISTER (REQ-NOT-004, Milan 5.4.5.3; `06_aecp_engine.md:893-897` and `:916`).
   - The reviewer showed that `&& !cx_wait_w[cf_ix_w]` on `cf_ok_w` (`KL_aecp_notify.sv:801-802`) closes it, with both cancels still sent once. Use that guard, or prove an equivalent.
   - Add a standing check of the reviewer's P1 case: a failure for the commanding owner presented one cycle after the coincidence must leave the registry entry and send no DEREGISTER. Add a planted control that removes the guard and is caught.
   - The base-timing and count-two behaviour must stay unchanged. Reuse the reviewer's P1/P2 probes.
2. Re-run the processor suites, lint, `make check`, the matrix check, Yosys, every campaign that builds the changed file, and the parent consumer gates. OOC 1x1 must stay within +20 LUT / +20 FF of processor main.

Commit on `f3fef224`, with no merge, rebase or amend. Then post REVIEW READY.

[A10] Manager correction `bcbf382e` on top of round 2 (R554-2-F1, docs only): `docs/architecture/09_verification.md` §8.4 now registers `tb/aecp_notify` SC (#167) and counts seven notification-block sections. `make check` rc 0. No RTL, test or record change. R554-3 and R555-3 review `bcbf382e`; the manager banks re-run at that head.

[A10] INDEPENDENT REVIEW STARTED: R555-3

R555 (external reviewer) reconstructs issue #167 / PR #169 at exact head `bcbf382e5f4d17ccfd8ae75a80bbc45902c75b7d`, tree `9a5bb28e18469943b28e1ece0194dc9693e0d5b7`, in a cleared context from public scope, requirements, diff and evidence, applying all five lenses with a reviewer-owned ledger. No source edits or merge while this review runs; merge still requires two independent positive reviews and the full completion bar.
